description: Fraud-desk agent over Vertex AI Agent Engine Memory Bank, Dataplex Universal Catalog and BigQuery. Memory Bank supplies conversational history, Dataplex authorises each read and resolves vocabulary, BigQuery supplies authoritative figures.
_comment_project: Replace `project` before deploying. The running application does NOT read this file; it reads the environment via backend/config.py. This descriptor exists for `adk deploy`.
_comment_memory: session_service_uri and memory_service_uri are intentionally omitted. The previous version set both to `memory://`, which is ADK's in-process store, so a deployment using it would have discarded every session and memory on restart while the README claimed a live Memory Bank. This application talks to Memory Bank directly through backend/memory_bank.py over the REST API, so no ADK memory service is configured.
